say:2:1141202001:1.text: The winner of the Warsong Festival?
say:2:1141202001:1.source_cn: 你问战歌节胜者的名号？

say:3:1141202002:1.text: People from all over will know soon enough... How troublesome.
say:3:1141202002:1.source_cn: 应该很快就会散播开……真是麻烦。

say:4:1141202003:1.text: Even the coin-chasin' Alkali knows 'bout the once-a-decade Warsong Festival in the Ashen Wastes... So you're the one who snagged the win.
say:4:1141202003:1.source_cn: 就连只关心钱财的咸水镇都听说过荒角沙漠十年一度的战歌节...

choice_prompt:5:1141202003.text: Even the coin-chasin' Alkali knows 'bout the once-a-decade Warsong Festival in the Ashen Wastes... So you're the one who snagged the win.
choice_prompt:5:1141202003.source_cn: 就连只关心钱财的咸水镇都听说过荒角沙漠十年一度的战歌节，原来你是获胜者。

say:6:1141202004:1.text: Alsa and I aren't strong enough to take on Lord Brutus. If it weren't for his injuries, he would've won the championship.
say:6:1141202004:1.source_cn: 现在的我和阿尔萨，还不能和布鲁特斯大人正面抗衡，如果不...

say:7:1141202005:1.text: Who would feel proud of a title that wasn't rightfully earned?
say:7:1141202005:1.source_cn: 谁会对名不副实的称号沾沾自喜。

say:8:1141202006:1.text: You're young and eager, but you don't grasp the weight of a big title. Whether you like it or not, it's gonna bring you plenty of gains.
say:8:1141202006:1.source_cn: 唉，年轻气盛，还不懂得名头响亮有多方便，不管喜不喜欢，...

say:9:1141202007:1.text: Like what? Make it easier to suppress others?

say:10:1141202008:1.text: Ha-ha. No need to go that far. You'll learn how much a shortcut can save ya when you're as old as me. There's opportunities out there waitin' for you, along with hefty bounties...
say:10:1141202008:1.source_cn: 哈哈，别说的那么难听。\n也许你到了我这个年纪，就会清...

say:13:1141202010:1.text: Young man, you've made it mighty clear you ain't fond of bounty hunters and power struggles. As a fella who makes his livin' by takin' on quests, I'm mighty curious.
say:13:1141202010:1.source_cn: 小兄弟，你一路都在说讨厌赏金猎人，讨厌名利相争，作为一...

say:14:1141202011:1.text: Fame and fortune might seem appealing, but what's it really that you care about?
say:14:1141202011:1.source_cn: 外在的名利只是表象，你在意的究竟是什么？

say:15:1141202012:1.text: ... I was born into the Grimmaw Clan, where competition and elimination are natural.
say:15:1141202012:1.source_cn: ……黑嚎，我出身的氏族，一个崇尚竞争与淘汰的氏族。

say:16:1141202013:1.text: In most cultures, parents raise their children with love and care.
say:16:1141202013:1.source_cn: 也许在你们眼里，让一个婴儿健康成长是父母该尽到的职责。

say:17:1141202014:1.text: But in the Grimmaw Clan, especially among the stronger members, parents are harsh on their kids. It's not uncommon for a weak baby to be abandoned.
say:17:1141202014:1.source_cn: 但在黑嚎，越是强大的父母，对自己的孩子越苛刻。抛弃瘦弱...

say:18:1141202015:1.text: Prominent families value fame and fortune. Over generations, the entire clan becomes slaves to vanity.
say:18:1141202015:1.source_cn: 越高位的家庭越重视名利，这样一代接着一代，整个氏族都沦...

say:19:1141202016:1.text: No wonder you harbor such resentment towards them.

say:21:1141202018:1.text: Titles mean nothing to me. I care about the Uru kids' health and future. I don't want them to end up like the Grimmaws.
say:21:1141202018:1.source_cn: 比起胜者的名号，我更在意的是乌尔氏族的孩子们能够健康长...

say:22:1141202019:1.source_cn: 吃饭吧，我要说的话已经说完了。

choice:12:0:1.text: Soren's not that kind of person.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 的确索恩不像这样的人
choice:12:0:1.male: Soren's not that kind of person.
choice:12:0:1.female: Soren's not that kind of person.

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 不过，胜者也确实会吸引更多目光
